title: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.isIso_boundedConstructibleBaseChange_of_isProper_padicAlgCl
statement: Let ℓ be a natural number with Fact ℓ.Prime, let k be a field with Fact (ringChar k).Prime and Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ), and let X,Y,X′,Y′ be schemes over Spec k whose structure morphisms are locally of finite type, quasi-compact, and separated. Let f : X ⟶ Y, g : Y′ ⟶ Y, f′ : X′ ⟶ Y′, and g′ : X′ ⟶ X be morphisms over Spec k, and let sq : IsPullback g′ f′ f g. If f is proper, then IsIso (boundedConstructibleBaseChange (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) ℓ k sq.toCommSq), the base-change natural transformation between the bounded constructible pro-étale derived categories with condensed Q̄_ℓ coefficients.

proof.text: Rewrite the isomorphism predicate for a natural transformation using the componentwise criterion NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app. The component theorem new-proper-qbar-basechange-app supplies IsIso for every object of the source category, so the target natural transformation is an isomorphism.
